summary: The cut is clean with no pops or render flicker, but he is jammed against the left edge and the blade the shot is built on isn't visible.

faults.what: He is pushed against the left edge. His back and left shoulder are cropped off and the right two-thirds of the frame is empty fence and house. This reads as bad framing rather than a deliberate quiet beat.
faults.fix: Pan or reframe so he sits at a third line with space in front of him, or push in on his face.

faults.what: The shot is meant to have the blade held up for 'it's not a big deal'. No blade is visible, and his right hand hangs low and open at his side, so the beat has no focal prop.
faults.fix: Raise the blade hand into frame at chest or face height, or recut the framing so the held-up blade is visible.
